AccountSearchTerm.title: Account Search Term
AccountSearchTerm.description: The account name or part of it, exactly as the user said it. Never substitute an account ID, contact name, or account executive name.

GenerateOutreach.title: Generate Outreach
GenerateOutreach.description: Set to true ONLY when the user asks for customer outreach, an email, or a message to send to the customer. Leave false or omit for every other request, including preparing, prepping, briefing, or reviewing an account. False produces the internal renewal brief; true produces a customer-facing email draft.
